subject: CS481
filterSummary: Successfully selected 5 English and 3 Arabic videos. The English coverage is strong, with highly relevant and popular videos for all topics. Arabic coverage is weaker, with no suitable videos found for 'Ethical Implications of Data Mining' and 'Opt-In vs Opt-Out Privacy Policies' as all candidates either failed the relevance or language gates. The selected Arabic videos are good fits for their respective topics.

coverage.note: All Arabic candidates teach the techniques of data mining, not the ethical implications, failing the relevance gate.
All relevant candidates were in English, failing the language gate. The one Arabic candidate was on an unrelated programming topic.
Most candidates were irrelevant (e.g., math lectures with 'natural' in the title). The selected video passed via the low-view-count exception rule.
